activation: proposed_not_enforced; no automatic external schedule or quota consumption
eligible_comparison: known matching Chrome/Lighthouse, viewport/DPR, CPU/network/cache, consent and resource policy
normal render and no-js/reduced-motion/counterfactual must never be pooled
unchanged measurement stage and new timestamps, no reuse of cache as independent sample

statistics.method_proposed: one-sided permutation test plus median tolerance; Holm correction across tested metrics, only when sample count permits
statistics.fewer_samples: insufficient_evidence or inconclusive, never invent confidence

budgets: Per-profile prospective tolerances in performance-baseline.json; field objectives separate from regression budgets
blocking: permission/privacy violation, HTTP/access error or incompatible provenance -> blocked
statistically supported regression beyond budget -> regression_detected and mandatory review
critical commerce/accessibility/SEO acceptance failure -> blocked; no model override
pending: Implement enforcement hook using existing QA/controller before relying on it as a deployment gate.
Capture at least5 comparable baseline samples when enabling statistical blocking.
Clean-window long-task and repeated DOM/resource samples before automatic budget activation.

cadence_proposed.before_local_changes: manual baseline then same-profile QA after changes
cadence_proposed.after_authorized_release: manual PSI representative pages and read-only functional check
cadence_proposed.weekly: CrUX/History review (rolling aggregated periods); only scheduled with explicit authorization
